title: Secret Invasion #1 Blank Sketch Variant + #2 Lot Marvel 2008 Bendis Leinil Yu
conditionDescription: #1: crease near spine, smudges and back-cover stains. #2: color-breaking wear along the spine and top edge, scuffing on the back. See photos.
descriptionText:
Lot of 2: Secret Invasion #1 (Blank Sketch Variant) and #2 (of 8), Marvel Comics 2008. Written by Brian Michael Bendis, art by Leinil Francis Yu. #2 cover by Gabriele Dell'Otto. Direct editions, $3.99 cover price each.

- #1 Blank Sketch Variant: ready for a sketch or signature. Crease near the spine at upper left, light smudges in the white sketch area, spots/stains on the white back cover.
- #2: color-breaking wear and chipping along the spine and top edge, scuffing on the back cover (Iron Man movie ad). Reading copy.

See photos for condition. Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
